# AUB HANDOFF Analysis

## Assessment
**Null champion state** - All 19 folds degenerate with zero exposure. This is a blank slate requiring initial model creation.

## Priority
Build any non-degenerate baseline that produces actual position signals (exposure > 0).

## Next Commands (3 lines)
```
python scripts/diagnose_lane.py --lane ost_v62_unified --check-features --check-targets
python train.py --config configs/simple_momentum.yaml --l2 1e-4 --min-exposure 0.05
python validate.py --model outputs/latest.pkl --report-degeneracy --lane ost_v62_unified
```

## Notes
- Zero exposure indicates model outputs constant/zero predictions
- Start with simple, robust features (momentum, volatility, mean-reversion)
- Use light regularization to avoid zero-weight collapse
- Target: beat OOS 3.6 baseline (any valid signal will achieve this)
